keepConnect.name: stay connected
keepConnect.helperText: If you click to start the link, then keep the link, so you need to pay attention to the fact that the link will keep reconnecting after it is disconnected.

url.name: URL
url.helperText: Link URL, such as ws://192.168.0.2:7001, or wws://example.com/path
url.error: The correct URL is a URL starting with ws:// or wwws://
